summary.value: Also known as Archaeologist, Delver, Spelunker.

system.description:
Built on Project FU's Dungeoneer.

ANTIQUARIAN SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000006]{Problem Solver} 【Max SL 6】

When a GM-imposed Clock resolves in your favour during a conflict scene, recover (SL × 5) MP — turning back the Miasma Clock counts. And +(SL ÷ 2) to Checks on the Objective action or when supporting a Group Check toward an Objective.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000007]{Vast Collection} 【Max SL 1】

Action + 1 Fabula Point: produce any Lucky Treasure you can describe from your supplies. It is gone at the end of the scene — describe why.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000008]{Treasure Magnet} 【Max SL 3】

When a travel roll results in a Discovery — on the world map or in a dungeon — find a Lucky Treasure worth up to (level × 10 × SL) zenit, GM-determined. And you may spend Opportunities on a critical success to gain (SL × 50) zenit.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000009]{Survival Instincts} 【Max SL 4】

All damage you suffer outside a conflict scene that is not from an Attack or Spell — travel dangers, ritual Catastrophes, harmful terrain or weather — is reduced by (SL × 3).
